text: The Nominating Panel – Corporations will conduct interviews and recommend three public members for appointment to the Waterfront Toronto Board.

The Corporations Nominating Panel recommends that: 1. City Council appoint the following candidates to the Waterfront Toronto Board, at pleasure of Council, for a term of office ending June 16, 2025, and until successors are appointed. Wende Cartwright Laurie Payne Jack Winberg 2. City Council direct that Confidential Attachments 1 to 4 to the report (May 10, 2022) from the City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Waterfront Toronto Board.
